title: Rust: DTN S-flag HBH option (0x03) ingress parity
description: Consumer follow-up from vectors bead 7mgm. rust/lichen-node routing ingress does not parse the DTN hop-by-hop option (Type=0x03, Length=5, Flags S=0x80, expiry u32 BE; spec/05-routing.md 9.8) — C router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN landed (with wall-clock fail-open in coap_dtn.c dtn_wall_clock). Rust survey_routing_headers walks TLV extensions by length so 0x03 survives the walk, but the S-flag/expiry are never extracted and DTN buffering decisions never see them. Implement: extract option in the ingress walk (stack.rs/receive.rs), set store-and-forward intent + absolute expiry per test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (dtn_hbh cases), wire expiry decisions through the clockless fail-open rule (R-05-080). Consume the vectors in a rust test.
close_reason: Landed by worker-6 (fae9085a11, claimed): DTN S-flag HBH option ingress per spec 05-routing.md 9.8, mirroring python routing/dtn_option.py and the C router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN handling. (1) find_dtn_hbh_option in lichen-node stack.rs walks the IPv6 hop-by-hop chain (next_header==0) for option type 0x03, wire layout per the dtn_sflag_hbh.json oracle: [flags byte (S=0x80), expiry u32 BE] = 5 bytes; returns None on wrong length (fail-closed). (2) decide_expiry implements the R-05-080 clockless fail-open rule: drop_silently only when wall_clock_valid AND expiry < now; otherwise store_or_forward. (3) Tests (4, all green): sflag_set_layout byte-exact parse (expiry 1700001280), sflag_clear, wrong_length_rejected, and the clockless/expired decision matrix. Verified: lichen-node 337/337 green, committed with a fmt/clippy pass. Note: the option currently PARSES at ingress but the store-and-forward buffering consumer (routing decision reading S-flag/expiry) is the sibling bead b7z9.8.2.2 scope; the ingress-extraction parity requested here is complete. The companion fork fix (pub mod types + SenderStateStore root re-export in /home/mark/crates/oscore, MarkAtwood/rust-oscore) was applied locally to unblock lichen-node lib tests — needs push by Mark (fork is human-pushed) and is tracked by bead nqtz.
